label: 1024-vBucket configuration
type: the larger Magma vBucket configuration and the count every non-Magma Couchbase bucket uses, with a minimum memory quota of 1 GiB per node. Migrating a bucket's storage backend to Magma always produces this count regardless of the source bucket's.
evidence: Magma supports two vBucket configurations: 128 or 1024
Magma using 1024 vBuckets has a minimum memory quota of 1 GiB per node.
Migrating to a Magma bucket always results in a bucket with 1024 vBuckets, regardless of the number of vBuckets in the source bucket.
note: Sibling of vbucket:vbucket-count-128; both cross the bar independently, so no family exception was needed. The migration asymmetry is the operationally sharp fact: an administrator can CREATE a 128-vBucket Magma bucket but cannot MIGRATE into one.
